name: advantageous-perch-distant-returns-a-ranger-action-and-banishes-itself
notes: Advantageous Perch: the champion becomes distant, Charge the Soul returns to hand and Perch banishes itself. Perch used to stay in the graveyard (and was offered as its own return target).

engineBug.summary: FIXED. Advantageous Perch's "Banish CARDNAME" used the variable mzID (the effect-stack slot) to find itself, but by the time a spell's effect runs it has already moved from the stack to the graveyard, so it was never banished and stayed in the graveyard. Fix: it is looked up in the graveyard (BanishResolvedSpellFromGraveyard).
